headline: Accounting Manager, CPA
summary: CPA and accounting manager with eleven years in audit, manufacturing and island hospitality. I lead the month-end close and statutory reporting under PFRS, run cost accounting and treasury, and keep the company compliant with BIR, SEC and lender requirements. I manage a team of five and report risks and results directly to the owners.
highlights: Shortened the month-end close from 12 working days to 6 after moving the group to SAP.
Led three clean external audits with no material adjustments.
Introduced product costing that showed two loss-making tour packages, which were repriced.
skills: Risk reporting to owners and lenders

experience.title: Accounting Manager
bullets: Lead a team of five covering payables, receivables, payroll accounting and tax for three resorts and a dive centre.
Prepare the consolidated financial statements and the reports required by the group's lenders.
Oversaw the move from spreadsheets to SAP and wrote the new close checklist.

experience.title: Senior Accountant
bullets: Ran the monthly close and product costing for a desiccated-coconut plant with 300 workers.
Prepared tax returns and the working papers for the annual audit.

experience.title: Audit Associate
bullets: Audited manufacturing, school and cooperative clients and drafted management letters.
Tested internal controls over purchasing and cash disbursements.
